existing_results_already_seen: Original national WAPE and single-factor baseline. These new tests are additional diagnostics, not an untouched final competition benchmark.
temporal: Report each test year, high/low activity strata fixed from training Aqua quartiles, and a whole-year bootstrap of held-out national WAPE (seed 20261114, 2000 replicates).
spatial: For each predefined study rectangle, exclude all its display cells from training, refit sector-quarter ratios on remaining Indonesia cells, test the excluded rectangle on the original later test years. Fall back to the training national-quarter factor only when sector support is zero; disclose fallback count.
ranges: Freeze existing factors. NPP: residual calibration 2018-2021, evaluate 2022-2025. NOAA20: residual calibration 2022-2023, evaluate 2024-2025. Calibrate the 90% finite-sample quantile of absolute error/(prediction+1). Evaluate reference coverage and width, never claim coverage of all actual fires or formal independence.
sensitivity: Refit and test original train/test periods at 0.5, 1, and 2 km; stricter MODIS >=80 and VIIRS high confidence; vegetation type 0 only; and daytime only. Report all configurations; do not select the best and relabel it as original performance.

case.reason: NASA Earth Observatory documented September 2019 fires and published separate Landsat 8 OLI observations. 2019 is outside the frozen NPP fitting years. 2020 is the following-year comparison, not assumed fire-free.
case.scope: Corroborate event existence and broad timing; no independent validation of complete hotspot counts, perimeter or attribution.

decision_rule: For each month, compare adjusted primary activity and the concurrent Aqua observation independently with the same-month Aqua 2003-2017 baseline excluding the selected year. Above historical 90th percentile means high activity; it is descriptive, not statistical significance. Require positive baseline and at least 10 historical years. Disagreement is sensor-sensitive; agreement does not establish ground truth.
